LESSON: HANDLING HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre - Technical Studies
Topic 1.2: Handling Hazardous Substances
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Handling Hazardous Substances, part of Foundations of Pre - Technical Studies in Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why are hazardous substances labelled? 2. How are hazardous substances handled?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use print or digital media to search for information on hazardous substances (poisonous, flammable, corrosive),

2. explore the environment to identify hazardous substances (poisonous, flammable, corrosive),

3. group hazardous substances into poisonous, flammable or corrosive,

4. discuss safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the environment,

5. read and interpret instructions on the conditions for use of hazardous substances,

6. visit the locality to learn about safe handling of poisonous, flammable and corrosive substances,

7. practise safe handling of poisonous, flammable and corrosive substances in the environment, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use print or digital media to search for information on hazardous substances (poisonous, flammable, corrosive),
2. explore the environment to identify hazardous substances (poisonous, flammable, corrosive),
3. group hazardous substances into poisonous, flammable or corrosive,
4. discuss safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the environment,
5. read and interpret instructions on the conditions for use of hazardous substances,
6. visit the locality to learn about safe handling of poisonous, flammable and corrosive substances,
7. practise safe handling of poisonous, flammable and corrosive substances in the environment, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Handling Hazardous Substances together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and self-expression skills when discussing safe ways

of handling hazardous substances.

• Learning to Learn: learner develops the skill of sharing learnt knowledge when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous

substances.

Values:
• Respect: learner appreciates diverse opinions when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the immediate

environment.

• Patriotism: learner respects fellow citizens when visiting the locality to learn about safe handling of poisonous, flammable and

corrosive substances.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Disaster Risk Reduction: learner’s ability to identify hazards is enhanced when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous

substances in the environment.

Link to other Subjects

Integrated Science: learner enhances knowledge on laboratory safety when practising safe handling of poisonous, flammable and

corrosive substances in the environment.
